title: Your First Weekend at CUNY Queens College, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Move-In Morning
cards.subtitle: 64-80 Kissena Blvd
cards.notes: Start your weekend by checking into your new home. New students typically move in during late August; remember to bring a photo ID to collect your keys and orientation pack.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus residential hall for Queens College students.
cards.evidence_claim: New students move in on specific dates in late August (e.g., August 26 for Fall 2026) and must bring a photo ID to the Housing Office.
cards.source_title: Move In - Summit Apartments - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Access restricted to residents and authorized guests; check-in requires a valid photo ID.

cards.title: The Ceremonial March
cards.subtitle: Kissena Blvd and 65th Ave
cards.notes: Join the tradition of marching through the main gate during Welcome Day. It symbolizes the opening of doors and opportunities for your academic journey as a new Knight.
cards.short_summary: The iconic entrance where new students participate in a traditional welcome ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: New students participate in a traditional ceremony to march through the main gate during Welcome Day.
cards.source_title: Welcome Day - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Open to all new students during the annual Welcome Day event.

cards.title: Presidential Welcome
cards.subtitle: Near the Main Entrance
cards.notes: Gather at this tree-lined lawn to be formally greeted by the college President and administrators. It is a key meeting point for orientation leaders and new peers.
cards.short_summary: A large outdoor plaza used for formal greetings and student gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: College administrators formally greet students at Alumni Plaza during Welcome Day activities.
cards.source_title: Welcome Day - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space on campus.

cards.title: Lunch at the Union
cards.subtitle: 152-45 Melbourne Ave
cards.notes: Head to the Student Union for a midday meal. It serves as a hub for student clubs and is the temporary home for many student services during campus renovations.
cards.short_summary: The central hub for student life, dining, and club activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Union provides dining services and is a primary location for Welcome Day lunch and icebreakers.
cards.source_title: Welcome Day - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 8 am-7 pm; summer hours may vary.

cards.title: Afternoon Concert
cards.subtitle: Central Campus Lawn
cards.notes: Relax on the 130,000-square-foot green space for a free concert. Past performers include mainstream artists like Waka Flocka Flame and Jay Sean.
cards.short_summary: The largest outdoor space on campus, hosting concerts and major events.
cards.evidence_claim: Welcome Day includes a FREE concert with mainstream artists on the Quad, open to all QC students.
cards.source_title: Welcome Day - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor space; concerts are typically scheduled during orientation and spring/fall fests.

cards.title: Library Exploration
cards.subtitle: Level 3 Entrance
cards.notes: Visit the library to activate your QCard and explore six levels of study space. Check out the Computer Commons on Level 2 for printing services.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library offering extensive research resources and study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The library has six levels of study areas and requires an active QCard for entry.
cards.source_title: Services | Benjamin S. Rosenthal Library - Queens College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Requires active QCard for entry; check website for current semester hours.

cards.title: Art Break
cards.subtitle: 405 Klapper Hall
cards.notes: Spend an hour viewing a collection of over 3,500 objects ranging from antiquity to modern prints by artists like Andy Warhol.
cards.short_summary: A teaching museum on campus with a diverse permanent art collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum's exhibitions and events are open to Queens College students and the public.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 10 am-4 pm; follows the academic calendar.

cards.title: Evening Workout
cards.subtitle: Second Floor Fitness Center
cards.notes: Get active at the fitness center. Remember to bring your QC ID and a towel, as entry is strictly enforced for students and staff.
cards.short_summary: The campus athletic facility featuring a fitness center and basketball courts.
cards.evidence_claim: Access to the Fitness Center is for current QC students with a valid ID and a mandatory towel.
cards.access_notes: Fall/Spring hours typically 12:00 PM-5:00 PM; sneakers and towel required.

cards.title: Evening Performance
cards.subtitle: 153-49 Reeves Avenue
cards.notes: Catch a show at the largest arts complex in Queens. Students often receive a 50% discount on select ticketed events with a valid ID.
cards.short_summary: A major performing arts complex hosting music, dance, and theater.
cards.evidence_claim: Current Queens College students receive a 50% discount on select events at the Kupferberg Center.
cards.source_title: Frequently Asked Questions - Kupferberg Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Box office hours vary; student discounts apply to select 'KCA Presents' events.

cards.title: Sunday Morning Stroll
cards.subtitle: Fresh Meadows Lane
cards.notes: Walk just off-campus to this historic park. It features a lake, nature trails, and a velodrome, offering a quiet escape from the city bustle.
cards.short_summary: A large public park adjacent to the Queens College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Kissena Park is a nearby destination for students, offering outdoor recreation and nature trails.
cards.source_title: QC Neighborhood - Student Life - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from dawn to dusk.
